# t7.5 — Named agents, skill wrappers, and bounded CRUD memory

## Summary

Implemented the requested additive agentic increment. Six named agents have fixed skill bindings and use the existing injected `ModelProvider` only when explicitly supplied. Eleven reusable skill modules expose bounded typed read-only ports. Added disabled-by-default JSON policy and prompt examples, a bounded policy parser, and an opt-in atomic file-backed CRUD memory store. Updated the framework guide with folder layout, Mermaid class relationships, integration workflow, implemented-vs-roadmap status, dependency policy, and production/security/scaling limits.

The existing Cucumber path remains unchanged by default: named agents/skills are not auto-registered, no provider is selected, and no new package dependency was added. No browser journey, target, or secret was accessed.

## Findings and Limitations

- No new HIGH or CRITICAL finding was identified in this implementation.
- No actual visual AI, external RAG/vector store, remote provider, API/database adapter, or remote telemetry is claimed or implemented.
- File memory is local, opt-in, non-encrypted, and single-process; production shared storage requires an approved transactional adapter, ACLs, encryption, retention, and tenant controls.
- Concrete injected skill/provider adapters remain trusted integration code and require separate review. Existing TLS/hook logging concerns were not modified by this task.
- Pre-existing unrelated edits in the worktree were preserved.
